mentions.name: quik.run
mentions.description: A platform for writing, sharing, and instantly running code snippets with support for imports and packages, without any setup, deployment, or infrastructure — a lightweight AWS Lambda for quick experiments.
mentions.problem: Quick code experiments normally require setup, deployment, and infrastructure work.
mentions.source_excerpt: It started as a simple platform for writing and sharing code snippets. Over time, it evolved into a way to run snippets instantly with support for imports and packages, without worrying about setup, deployment, or infrastructure. Think of it as a lightweight AWS Lambda for quick experiments.
mentions.author: nparashar150
